items.summary: Yes, a lab-grown diamond is a 100% real diamond — same optical, physical, chemical properties (pure carbon, same crystal lattice, 10 on Mohs scale) and passes standard diamond testers, graded by 4Cs via IGI/similar labs. Differences: origin (billions of years vs weeks via HPHT/CVD), price (40-70% less), and resale value (natural retains more value).
